description: Phases, activities and direct costs of the calculator. phases maps each research phase key to a description of the phase. Activities and direct costs are offered in the calculator's selectboxes, grouped by phase. phase is a research phase key ("incubation", "data" or "writing"). default_hours is a typical number of hours of labor for an activity. default_cost is a typical direct cost in US dollars. description describes what the activity or direct cost covers.

incubation.description: The incubation phase includes ideation and conception of the research questions, applications for ethics approval from an Institutional Review Board, and applications for grants (both successful and unsucessful).

data.description: This phase encompasses all activities and direct costs involved in carrying out the research.

writing.description: Encompasses the writing of the manuscript. This should include the presentation of versions of the manuscript to peers, such as at seminars and conferences, as peer feedback is generally crucial for the development of journal articles. Also include the time spent on revising manuscripts for resubmission.

editing.description: To calculate the cost of peer review and journal editing, please provide the number of journals that the manuscript was submitted to (including rejections) and the average number of peer review rounds (i.e. the initial submission plus revise and resubmits) across journal submissions.

activities.name: Ideation and conception
activities.description: Developing the research question, reviewing the literature and designing the study.

activities.name: Ethics approval
activities.description: Preparing and revising applications to an institutional review board (also known as an ethic committee in some countries). The labor of institutional review board members and related administrative costs are indirect costs and should not be included.

activities.name: Grant applications
activities.description: Writing, revising and submitting applications for funding for the project. Include time spent on failed grant applications. If multiple refereed journal publications were derived from a grant application, divide the time spent (including on failed applications) by the number of papers.

activities.name: Other
activities.description: Any other incubation activity not listed above.

activities.name: Data collection
activities.description: The carrying out of the research in general. Gathering data, e.g. from databases or through surveys, interviews, clinical studies, experiments or fieldwork. Includes recruiting participants for qualitative and clinical studies.

activities.name: Interview transcription
activities.description: Transcribing recorded interviews or focus groups into text for analysis.

activities.name: Data analysis
activities.description: Cleaning, coding and analysing the data, and interpreting the results.

activities.name: Other
activities.description: Any other data collection or analysis activity not listed above.

activities.name: Writing and manuscript preparation
activities.description: Drafting, revising and formatting the manuscript for submission to a journal. Includes revisions of a manuscript for resubmission to a journal.

activities.name: Conferencing (labor)
activities.description: Time spent preparing for, travelling to and presenting the research at conferences.

activities.name: Other
activities.description: Any other manuscript preparation activity not listed above.

direct_costs.name: Other
direct_costs.description: Any other direct costs of the incubation phase.

direct_costs.name: Participant incentivization
direct_costs.description: Payments, vouchers or gifts given to participants for taking part in the study.

direct_costs.name: Travel for data collection
direct_costs.description: Costs associated with travel for the purposes of data collection.

direct_costs.name: Digital ranscription services
direct_costs.description: Cost of digital transcription services. If a human transcription service was hired and the hours and hourly rate is known, add the transcriber as a researcher and add transcription as an activity.

direct_costs.name: Software
direct_costs.description: Licences or subscriptions for software acquired specifically for the research, e.g. for analysis or surveys. Generally, software provided by the researcher's institution would be considered an indirect cost and should not be included.

direct_costs.name: Databases
direct_costs.description: Access fees for databases or datasets acquired specifically for the research. Generally, databases provided by the researcher's institution would be considered an indirect cost and should not be included.

direct_costs.name: Equipment
direct_costs.description: Costs of equipment acquired specifically for the research. Generally, equipment provided by the researcher's institution would be considered an indirect cost and should not be included.

direct_costs.name: Other
direct_costs.description: Any other direct costs of the data colleciton and analysis phase.

direct_costs.name: Conferencing (direct costs)
direct_costs.description: Registration fees, travel and accommodation for presenting the research at conferences.

direct_costs.name: Proofreading and Editing Services
direct_costs.description: Professional proofreading, copyediting or language editing of the manuscript.

direct_costs.name: Other
direct_costs.description: Any other direct costs of the manuscript preparation phase.
